rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
BE = Δm c²
N = N₀ e^(−λt)
t_½ = ln2 / λ

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Mass defect" as one blob → ✅ split into: mass defect, packing fraction, binding energy per nucleon.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Mass defect Δm = Z m_p + N m_n − M; binding energy BE = Δm c²; BE per nucleon peaks near Fe-56 (~8.8 MeV).  ·  Radioactive decay: N = N₀e^(−λt), t_½ = ln2/λ; activity A = λN.
